name: Interpose
description:
Choose an adjacent creature you have attacked and hit this combat. For the next minute:

  • Any time the chosen creature would attack a creature other than you while you are adjacent to it, you become the target of the attack.

  • Any time you make an opportunity attack against the chosen creature and land a hit, you may spend 1 MP to shift around the creature to any space adjacent to it, and you regain 1 reaction.

These effects end if you attack a creature other than the chosen creature, or if the chosen creature becomes further than medium range from you.

Describe how you keep their attention.
